purpose: Per-task split of environment variables into local state (what the policy observes at one step) and global memory (latent world variables the policy must build, update or keep frozen across steps). scripts/experiments/task_generation_audit.py extracts exactly these global-memory variables from generated cases and checks the control effects listed here.

local_state.rgb: Current egocentric RGB frame without identifier overlays
local_state.memory: Policy-written notebook (replaced by each action that carries memory)

controls.seed: Selects every random choice; identical recipes must regenerate identical variables and first frame
controls.difficulty: Structural level; its per-task effect is listed under controls.difficulty
controls.max_steps: Episode action budget; generators reject cases whose witness cannot fit
controls.task_config.start_pose: AI2-THOR memory_maze/dependency_doors/relational_rearrangement/dynamic_replanning: 'fixed' (default, first sorted reachable position facing +z) or 'seeded' (seed-chosen position and heading from a separate random stream)

lifecycle_terms.build: Steps where the policy acquires the latent variables from observations
lifecycle_terms.update: Events after which remembered values become stale and must be revised
lifecycle_terms.freeze: Values that must stay fixed (or are committed) and are used as the evaluation reference

global_memory.target_type: Object type of the object that will be removed (hidden from the policy)
global_memory.support_type: Type of its supporting receptacle (the answer's previous_location)
global_memory.target_visible_at_start: Whether the target is visible from the initial camera view
global_memory.target_distance_m: Planar distance from the start pose to the target
global_memory.exposed_objects: Number of exposed pickupable objects on receptacles: the memory load a survey must cover
global_memory.support_count: Number of supporting receptacles of the target

lifecycle.build: Memorization stage: survey views and notebook entries of object-receptacle pairs
lifecycle.update: None by the agent; the environment removes one object after MEMORIZE
lifecycle.freeze: MEMORIZE freezes memory_checkpoint and the set of pre-change views that count as evidence

missing_object.memory_reward: Strict success needs the correct object and original receptacle, each referenced from pre-change pixels (pre_change_evidence)

controls.difficulty: L1: target bbox >= 100 px; L2: 8..1800 px and start view turned 120 degrees away; L3 rejected
controls.task_config.memory_protocol: active_scan_v1: target hidden at start, single visible support, explicit MEMORIZE, no automatic transition
controls.task_config.exploration_budget: Actions available before MEMORIZE must be issued

global_memory.target_type: Object type of the object that will be relocated
global_memory.target_visible_at_start: Whether the target is visible from the initial camera view
global_memory.target_distance_m: Planar distance from the start pose to the target
global_memory.relocation_distance_m: Planar distance between the original and the planned new position
global_memory.exposed_objects: Number of exposed pickupable objects on receptacles
global_memory.support_count: Number of supporting receptacles of the target

lifecycle.update: After MEMORIZE the target's location changes; the policy must search and bind the new receptacle
lifecycle.freeze: MEMORIZE freezes memory_checkpoint and the pre-change evidence views

moved_object.memory_reward: Strict success needs object, original receptacle (pre-change pixels) and new receptacle

controls.difficulty: L1/L2 as missing_object; L3 is the default moved-object level

global_memory.voxels: Number of cubes in the target shape
global_memory.candidates: Number of candidate shapes in the fixed panel
global_memory.correct_index: 1-based panel position of the correct candidate
global_memory.distinct_candidates: Whether all candidates are distinct up to rotation
global_memory.ambiguous_distractor: Whether a distractor shares the target's front silhouette
global_memory.initial_pixel_twins: Wrong candidates whose initial target rendering is pixel-identical to the answer
global_memory.witness_actions: Length of the verified camera path that resolves the initial ambiguity (0 if not required)
global_memory.initial_rotation_identity: Whether the target starts in the canonical orientation
global_memory.occlusion: Occluder strength in the target view

lifecycle.build: Accumulate a 3D shape belief across camera viewpoints
lifecycle.update: Each camera move adds evidence; the object itself never changes
lifecycle.freeze: Candidate panel and target geometry are fixed for the episode

shape_identification.memory_reward: SUBMIT_SHAPE accuracy; with require_initial_pixel_ambiguity a no-move guess is at most 1/(1+twins)

controls.difficulty: voxels = 5+L; candidates = min(5, 2+L); random initial rotation for L>1; occlusion 0.35 for L>=4
controls.task_config.voxels / candidates / initia: Explicit overrides of the difficulty defaults
controls.task_config.require_initial_pixel_ambigu: Admit only cases with a pixel-identical twin and a bounded revealing camera path

global_memory.voxels: Number of cubes in the object
global_memory.alignment_length: Shortest number of quarter turns from the start to the reference pose (symmetry-aware)
global_memory.initially_aligned: Whether the start pose already matches the reference
global_memory.initial_rotation_identity: Whether the object starts in the canonical orientation
global_memory.occlusion: Occluder strength in the target view

lifecycle.build: Estimate the object's current orientation relative to the reference
lifecycle.update: Every OBJECT_ROTATE changes the object pose; camera moves change only the view

pose_alignment.memory_reward: SUBMIT_POSE succeeds only at zero symmetry-aware rotation error

controls.difficulty: alignment_length = min(L, 3) quarter turns (3 is the cube-rotation diameter); voxels = 5+L; random start pose for L>1; occlusion 0.35 for L>=4
controls.task_config.alignment_length: Explicit rotation depth; capped by the deepest pose the allowed axes reach
controls.task_config.axes: Restricts rotation actions and reference generation to these axes
controls.task_config.initial_rotation: Index of the start orientation among the 24 cube rotations

global_memory.landmark_types: Types of the ordered landmarks to revisit
global_memory.returns_to_first: Whether the order ends at the first landmark
global_memory.publicly_describable: Whether every landmark has a unique public description
global_memory.visible_at_start: Number of distinct landmarks visible from the start pose
global_memory.min_landmark_spacing_m: Smallest planar distance between two distinct landmarks

lifecycle.build: Exploration phase: landmark locations and routes
lifecycle.update: Recall progress pointer advances after each correct MARK
lifecycle.freeze: MEMORIZE freezes the notebook and returns the camera to the start

memory_maze.memory_reward: Ordered visits; MARK needs the landmark visible within 1.6 m

controls.difficulty: distinct landmarks = min(4, 1+L); L>=2 returns to the first landmark
controls.task_config.memory_protocol: explicit_recall_v1 disables the automatic exploration-to-recall switch

global_memory.sources_closed_at_start: Whether every source container starts closed
global_memory.object_inside_source: Whether every object starts inside its source
global_memory.closed_pickup_rejected: Native check that pickup through a closed container fails

lifecycle.build: Locations of containers, items and destinations
lifecycle.update: Container open/closed state, held object and delivered set change after every interaction

dependency_doors.memory_reward: All orders delivered in sequence, sources closed, hand empty

controls.difficulty: orders = L (sources may be shared); if existing contents verify fewer than L dependencies, one accessible source is seeded with native pickup/put and verification repeats once

global_memory.anchor_type: Anchor that defines the world-frame relation
global_memory.relation_axes: Signed world axes in the goal relation
global_memory.slots: Number of placement slots on the surface
global_memory.goal_witness_holds: Recomputed relation holds at the goal witness slot
global_memory.wrong_witness_fails: Recomputed relation fails at the incorrect witness slot
global_memory.satisfying_slots: Number of slots satisfying the relation

lifecycle.build: World-frame compass, anchor position and slot layout
lifecycle.freeze: Anchor and all other objects must remain unchanged (protected)

relational_rearrangement.memory_reward: Relation satisfied, protected objects preserved, hand empty

controls.difficulty: L1-L2: one signed axis; L3: two axes; L>=2 adds near <= 0.85 m
controls.task_config.fixture_order: 'size' (default: smallest scene-unique props first) or 'seeded' (seed-shuffled anchor/target candidates)
controls.task_config.max_satisfying_fraction: Relations satisfied by at most this fraction of slots are tried first (default 0.5; 1.0 restores unordered selection)

global_memory.obstacle_type: Native object moved to block the original route
global_memory.baseline_route_steps: Shortest route length from the checkpoint before the change
global_memory.detour_route_steps: Shortest route length after the change
global_memory.intervention_planned: Whether a natively verified blocking intervention exists (applied when the checkpoint is reached)

lifecycle.build: Route map while travelling to the checkpoint
lifecycle.update: At the checkpoint an obstacle blocks an edge; the remembered route must be revised

dynamic_replanning.memory_reward: Checkpoint reached, goal marked, finish at goal

controls.task_config.min_detour_steps: Minimum extra route length forced by the obstacle (default 2)
